title: Alternative form of Stoke's Law settling velocity in terms of specific gravity
applicability: Stoke's Law settling velocity written with the specific gravity of the grit particle, printed as the unnumbered alternative after 'or'.
notes: Unnumbered: p343-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.
Printed with no left-hand side, following the word "or" beneath equation (5.4).
Definitions of g, Ss, d and nu are printed in the symbol list on physical page 344.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs, plus enlarged crops at 288-720 dpi and a contact sheet of every hashed source region; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First visual transcription only. Every printed glyph, power, subscript, inequality, unit, hyphen spacing, footnote and printed error was read from the rendered source and retained or flagged; no value inferred.
